newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire rebels agree to airlift for refugees.
newsitem.headline: Zaire rebels agree to airlift for refugees.

text.p: Zairean rebels agreed on Saturday to a repatriation airlift for up to 100,000 Rwandan Hutu refugees, European Union special envoy Aldo Aiello told reporters.
"I've got a message just a few minutes ago from Mr (Laurent) Kabila that the Kisangani airport will be open and will be made available for the repatriation of refugees," he said in Kasangani.
Filippo Grandi of the U.N. refugee agency UNHCR said he hoped the airlift with chartered aircraft could start in a few days. He said it might last two to three months.
He said his earlier estimate that the airlift would cost $50 million was wrong and the cost would be lower.
Kabila's senior official dealing with the United Nations, Emmanuel Kamanze, flew to Kisangani with Aiello from rebel headquarters in Goma to confirm the airlift agreement.
